title: Lula wins Brazil election in dramatic comeback

slides.headline: Lula wins Brazil election in dramatic comeback
slides.subtitle: The incumbent secures a fourth term as president

slides.explanation: This election represents a massive pivot for the largest nation in South America. It marks the return of a former leader to the top office after a highly contested race.

slides.headline: The first round did not go his way
slides.explanation: Lula actually trailed behind his challenger Flávio Bolsonaro in the initial round of voting. He managed to overcome that deficit to win the final runoff.
Four major international news outlets, including the BBC and Al Jazeera, have independently verified these election results. This broad consensus confirms the outcome.

caption:
Brazil has finalized its presidential election results.

After a heated campaign, Lula has secured a fourth term in office.

His path to victory was not straightforward. He started by trailing behind his right-wing rival Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round of voting.

This comeback highlights just how divided the electorate remains. We have gathered the details on what this means for the country's future.
